units.source_text: 源氏公子走进室内，对她言道：

en.t: Prince Genji entered the room and said to her:

units.source_text: “别来已隔多年，我心始终不变，常常思念于你。

en.t: "Many years have passed since we parted, yet my heart has never changed, and I have often thought of you.

units.source_text: 但你不来睬我，教我心中怨恨。

en.t: But you never paid me any heed, and that left resentment in my heart.

units.source_text: 为欲试探你心，一直挨到今天。

en.t: Because I wished to test your feelings, I endured it until today.

units.source_text: 你家门前的树木虽非杉树，但我望见了不能过门不入。

en.t: Though the trees before your gate are not cedars, once I saw them I could not pass by without entering.
I cannot resist you any longer; I admit defeat."

units.source_text: 他把帷屏上的垂布略微拉开些，向内张望，

en.t: He drew the hanging cloth on the screen slightly aside and peered within,

units.source_text: 但见末摘花照旧斯文地坐着，并不立刻答话。

en.t: and saw that Suetsumuhana was seated as gracefully as ever, without answering at once.

units.source_text: 但她想起公子不惮冒霜犯露，亲来荒邸访问，

en.t: But when she thought how the prince had braved frost and dew to visit her desolate mansion in person,

units.source_text: 觉得这盛情深可感激，便振作起来，回答了寥寥数语。

en.t: she felt deeply grateful for such kindness, gathered herself, and answered with a few brief words.

units.source_text: “你躲在这荒草丛中，度送了长年的辛酸生涯，我很能体谅你这点苦心。

en.t: "You have hidden yourself among these wild grasses and passed many bitter years; I understand very well the pain you have endured.

units.source_text: 我自己一向不变初心，因此不问你心是否变易，贸然冒霜犯露而来，不知你对我作何感想？

en.t: As for me, my first feelings have never changed, and so, without asking whether your heart had changed, I rashly came through frost and dew; I wonder what you think of me.

units.source_text: 这几年来，我对世人一概疏远，想你定能原谅。

en.t: For these past few years I have kept my distance from everyone, and I believe you will surely forgive me.

units.source_text: 今后倘有辜负你心之处，我应负背誓之罪。”

en.t: If from now on I should ever betray your heart, I shall bear the guilt of breaking my vow."

units.source_text: 说的这些情深意密的话，怕也有点言过其实吧。

en.t: These words of deep feeling and close affection were perhaps a little more than the truth.

units.source_text: 至于泊宿，则因邸内一切简陋，实不堪留，只得巧设借口，起身告辞。

en.t: As for spending the night, everything in the mansion was so shabby that he truly could not stay, so he found a tactful excuse, rose, and took his leave.
